entities.summary: Salvador Minguijón Adrián (1874–1959) was a Spanish law scholar, political theorist and politician. As a lawyer he is known mostly as a longtime academic in the University of Zaragoza and briefly member of the Spanish constitutional court. As a theorist he is considered one of key representatives of Traditionalism. As a politician he is recognized as associated with Carlism, Christian Democracy, Primoderiverismo, Social Catholicism and early Francoism. Salvador Minguijón Adrián was a philosophers & thinkers from Calatayud (1874-06-23, Calatayud–1959-07-16). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
